# Kinterest

> Shared family pocket-money ledger for recording balances without moving real money.

## Documentation

- [Run the app](https://github.com/forgesworn/kinterest/blob/main/README.md): Current scope, development commands and Android build.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/forgesworn/kinterest/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Implemented behaviour and planned work.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/kinterest): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
